name: flaky-ci-watcher
description: Watch your open PRs (all across every repo by default, drafts included; or one specific PR by number in the current repo), auto re-run flaky CI failures, and alert in the terminal when a failure looks real or stays flaky
author: Philipp Hofmann

permissions: Actions: re-run workflow jobs (gh run rerun)

configuration.scope_default: all my open PRs across all repositories, drafts included
configuration.scope_targeted: one PR by number in the current repo (mine only)
